**My pick for a 2kWh RV power station under $900 is the <Entity category="product" value="Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO"/>**, especially if value and a built-in 30A RV outlet are your priorities.

The supplied October 2026 search results rank it #1 among large RV power stations, at approximately $676. It offers 2,048Wh of LiFePO4 battery capacity and 2,400W AC output. <Cite ref="turn907083view0"/>

## Best options compared

| Model | Listed price | Capacity | AC output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO** | **$676.16** | 2,048Wh | 2,400W |
| <Entity category="product" value="OUPES Mega 2 Pro"/> | $699 | 2,048Wh | 2,500W |
| <Entity category="product" value="BLUETTI AC200L"/> | $854.05 with code | 2,048Wh | 2,400W |
| <Entity category="product" value="Renogy PowerStation 2000"/> | $799 | 2,048Wh | 2,400W |
| <Entity category="product" value="Jackery Explorer 2000 v2"/> | $899 reported | 2,042Wh | 2,200W |

<caption>Prices are from the supplied search results, mostly checked in October 2026. They are not live checkout quotes.</caption>

## Which should you buy?

<row align=start gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO portable power station product" aspectRatio="1:1" maxWidth="136px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **Best value: Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO**

    At $676.16, it provides the same 2,048Wh capacity and 2,400W output as several more expensive options. Its built-in TT-30 RV outlet is particularly useful.
  </box>
</row>
<divider color="subtle"/>
<row align=start gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="BLUETTI AC200L 2048Wh portable power station product" aspectRatio="1:1" maxWidth="136px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **Alternative: BLUETTI AC200L**

    <text color="default" weight="medium">$854.05 with promo code AFF5OFF</text>

    A good RV-focused alternative with a 30A outlet, 2,400W inverter, and up to 1,200W solar input. The supplied Dealectric result lists this discounted price.

    <Link url="https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l" title="View BLUETTI deal"/>
  </box>
</row>

## Important RV consideration

A 30A RV outlet does **not** mean the power station can deliver 30 amps continuously. A 2,400W inverter supplies approximately 20A at 120V.

That is generally suitable for lights, a refrigerator, water pump, and some small appliances, but not for running all RV appliances simultaneously. A rooftop air conditioner may exceed its output or consume the battery quickly.

**Bottom line:** Buy the Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO if its approximately $676 price is still available. Choose the BLUETTI AC200L if you prefer its solar-input capability and the discounted offer is confirmed at checkout.
